svg.aria-label: Sebastian Kallfelz. Animated cutaway of a High-NA EUV lithography scanner, light running from tin plasma through mirrors to the wafer.
svg.text: Microelectronics at KIT · tools for lithography, process and yield
High-NA EUV scanner, cut away. A CO₂ laser turns tin droplets into plasma; its 13.5 nm light travels by mirrors only, from mask to wafer. Illustration, not to scale.
